greeting: Hi! I'm the ApplyWise assistant. Ask me anything about finding jobs, your resume or hiring.
fallback: Sorry, I don't have an answer for that yet. Try one of the suggested questions below.

questions.question: What is ApplyWise?
questions.answer: ApplyWise is an AI-powered job platform. You upload your resume once, see how well you match each job and apply in one click.

questions.question: How do I upload my resume?
questions.answer: Go to My Resume and drop your PDF (max 5 MB). Our AI reads it and fills in your profile automatically.

questions.question: How is my match score calculated?
questions.answer: We compare the skills in your resume with the skills a job needs. More matching skills means a higher score.

questions.question: What is an ATS score?
questions.answer: It shows how easily hiring software can read your resume. We also give tips like missing keywords and formatting fixes.

questions.question: How can I improve my resume?
questions.answer: Open My Resume and check the ATS analysis tab. Add missing keywords, write a short summary and keep a simple layout.

questions.question: How do I apply for a job?
questions.answer: Open any job from Search Jobs and click Apply. Your parsed resume is attached automatically.

questions.question: How do I track my applications?
questions.answer: Go to My Applications to see each application's status: Applied, Under Review, Shortlisted, Hired or Rejected.

questions.question: How do recruiters post a job?
questions.answer: Recruiters open Post New Job, add the role details and required skills, then publish. Applicants are ranked by AI match.

questions.question: Is ApplyWise free for job seekers?
questions.answer: Yes. Creating an account, uploading your resume and applying for jobs is free for job seekers.

questions.question: Is my data safe?
questions.answer: Your resume is only shared with recruiters for jobs you apply to. You can replace or delete it anytime.
